answer: The delta assignment is published and ember records each panel. Shards are assigned from the haven graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1959 identities would post 3311 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
